answer: We formalize the decentralized ledger as a directed vine of state transitions where dynamic opportunity-cost bonds require validators to lock capital across an escalating mesa of collateral tiers. A subgame-perfect slashing matrix exacts exponential penalties that prune fraudulent nodes down to a barren terrace, rendering identity multiplication mathematically unprofitable. Consequently, the adversarial expected payoff strictly decreases below the zero bound, forcing rational agents into a robust Nash equilibrium of single-identity participation.
